info.title: Arcmira API
info.description: Search YouTube transcripts for timestamped passages. Find mentions of people, organizations, products and topics; research channel sponsors and recommendations; retrieve creator captions or Premium transcripts with speaker identification; and monitor entities for new mentions. Official API guides: https://arcmira.com/docs. An explicit Premium read uses credits from the account's plan, then its on-demand budget.

X-Request-Id.description: The request id, echoed from an X-Request-Id request header or minted as req_<uuid>. error.request_id carries the same value. Quote it when reporting a problem.

X-Arcmira-Version.description: The API version that answered. Always v1.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per 60-second window for this credential, as GET /v1/me rate_limit reports.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: An estimate of the requests left in the current window. Limits are counted at each Cloudflare location, so it can read high; a 429 is the final word.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window ends.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. error.retry_after_seconds carries the same value on an error.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when this is the stored response to an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; the request did not run again.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry-After carries the wait.

type.description: The error class. It fixes the HTTP status: invalid_request_error 400, authentication_error 401, quota_exceeded 402, permission_error 403, not_found 404, conflict_error 409, rate_limit_error 429, server_error 500. Switch on it for retry and gate handling.

code.description: The specific condition, stable and snake_case; doc_url anchors on it. x-arcmira-codes on this schema lists every code with its type, gate and meaning. The list is open: new codes may appear inside an existing type, so switch on type and gate first.

reason.description: Only on invalid_api_key. no_credential: nothing was sent. invalid: a credential was sent and is unknown or malformed. revoked: the key exists and is no longer usable.

message.description: One plain line. Names the fix or the unlock.

param.description: The query or body parameter the gate refused, when one did.

gate.description: Which boundary refused. Present on every gate error; switch on it without parsing the message.

tier.description: The plan that lifts the gate.

url.description: Absolute upgrade or sign-up URL carrying its ?src= attribution. Use it verbatim.

offer.description: Reserved for the agent-discount offer. Always null today.

kind.description: What the call does. send_signup_code sends a verification code to an address for an account key.

url.description: Absolute endpoint carrying its ?src= attribution. Call it verbatim.

action.description: The request that lifts the gate with no human, present when the caller can fix this itself. A key gate carries the signup send here; a plan or quota gate has no action and its url is a page a person opens.

unlock.description: How to lift the gate. Present when the gate has an unlock.

retry_after_seconds.description: Present on rate gates. Mirrors the Retry-After header.

url.description: On terms_acceptance_required: the page where the person accepts the updated Terms of Service. On terms_updated: the Terms of Service page.

details.description: Machine data the refusal carries for you to act on. Present only on the codes that name a field here.

oneOf.description: Where results stop on a plan that reads media after a delay.

Limit.description: On quota_exceeded, spend_limit_exceeded, member_limit, fair_use_cap and freshness_requires_paid: the limit the refusal met. Absent when the server holds no figure for it.

delay_days.description: Days after publication before this plan reads a video.

served_through.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Results on this plan stop at this publish date; media published after it is not read.

Freshness.description: Where results stop on a plan that reads media after a delay.

id.description: Transcription request id (UUID).

state.description: Coarse outcome: pending until the Premium transcript is servable (ready), the job failed, or it was refunded.

status.description: Request status. Values: queued (accepted; audio download not started), downloading (fetching the video audio), transcribing (premium speech-to-text is running), analyzing (entity/commercial analysis is running), complete (premium transcript is servable via GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}), failed (rejected intent, or a legacy request needing accounting review), refund_pending (refund transaction must still complete), refunded (terminal failure; the charge was returned and the unlock this request granted was revoked).

stage.description: User-facing stage: downloading folds into transcribing. Values: queued (waiting to start), transcribing (downloading or transcribing), analyzing (analysis running). Null for terminal statuses and refund_pending.

amount.description: Credits this job charged. 0 when a prior unlock made it free.

from.description: Where the credits came from. included is the plan's credits, on_demand is the on-demand budget, mixed is both. Present once the job is funded.

charge.description: What the job charged. Absent only on legacy requests.

eta_seconds.description: Estimated seconds until completion, re-derived from live pipeline telemetry on every poll. Only present while the request is in flight; absent on refund_pending, which has no completion ETA.

next_poll_seconds.description: Seconds to sleep before the next poll (also sent as the Retry-After header). Only present while the request is in flight.

error.description: Failure reason. Only present when state is failed or refunded, or status is refund_pending.

refunded.description: True when the charge was returned. Only present when state is failed or refunded, or status is refund_pending (false until the refund lands).

completed_at.description: When the request reached a terminal status. Absent while in flight.

status_url.description: Absolute URL to read again for this job: GET /v1/transcripts/{video_id}?quality=premium, which answers 202 while it transcribes, 200 ready once it is done, and 200 failed if it failed.

TranscriptionJob.description: A Premium transcript job with its processing state, charge and URL for reading the transcript again.

status.description: Always "ok" when the API is reachable.

url.description: Contact URL.
Base URL.

servers.description: Base URLs the API is served from.

paths.description: Every operation, keyed by path then HTTP method. An open map: each value is an OpenAPI path item object.

components.description: Shared schemas and security schemes, keyed by component kind then name. An open map of OpenAPI component objects.

OpenApiDocument.description: This OpenAPI 3.1 document, the one you are reading.

user_id.description: Id of the user the API key belongs to.

key_id.description: Id of the credential making this request: the account key id, or the OAuth token id. Never a secret. Null on a browser session.

key_label.description: The key name set in the dashboard, or the name of the connected OAuth client. Null when none is known.

credential_kind.description: How the request authenticated: account_key is an arc_sk_ key, oauth is a token from a connected client, session is a signed-in browser.

email_masked.description: The email of the person calling (user_id), with the local part masked after its first character, e.g. z***@example.com. Null when the person has none.

period_resets_at.description: ISO 8601 time the plan credits reset: 00:00 UTC on the first of next month, on every plan.

id.description: Id of the account this request spends: the person's own account, or the team account a key or OAuth token was made in.

name.description: The team name when the account is a team, else the account holder's name. Null when the account has no name.

kind.description: team when the account is a team, personal otherwise.

plan.description: The account's plan tier, the same value as tier.

account.description: The account whose credits and plan this request uses. user_id is the person; this is who pays.

role.description: The person's role on the account: owner of their own account, or admin or member of a team.

tier.description: Plan tier, e.g. free, pro, pro_plus, ultra, enterprise.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to this API key, e.g. read, monitors:write, trackers:write, recommendations:read.

rate_limit.description: Requests allowed per 60-second window for this key: 600 for enterprise, 240 for other paid tiers, 60 for free, unless a per-key override is set.

recommendations_api_enabled.description: True when the plan includes the Recommendations API (commercial intelligence endpoints).

allOf.description: Where results stop for this account now: the free plan, and a paid plan past its usage limit, read media after a delay. Dated reads cut their window at served_through and say so. Null when results are current.

rows_used.description: Plan credits used this month, in rows (a row is 4 credits): usage.credits.plan.used divided by 4, rounded up.

rows_remaining.description: Credits left from the plan and grants, on-demand excluded, in rows (a row is 4 credits): divided by 4, rounded up.

monthly_rows.description: Plan credits a month, in rows (a row is 4 credits): usage.credits.plan.credits divided by 4 when the plan has a limit.

current_spend_cents.description: On-demand overage spend so far this period, in US cents.

available.description: Credits spendable now: plan, granted, and on-demand up to its cap. Null when nothing limits it.

credits.description: Plan credits this month. Null when the plan has no limit.

resets_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the first day of next month (UTC), when plan credits reset.

granted.description: Credits left in granted lots that have not expired.

enabled.description: True when on-demand credits are on.

cap_credits.description: The on-demand budget in credits. On-demand usage costs $0.002 a credit, so this is the dollar budget divided by 0.002. Null when uncapped or off.

credits.description: The month in credits, the primary measure of usage. Every read uses credits from the plan, then the on-demand budget. An included plan credit is valued at $0.001; on-demand usage costs $0.002 a credit. A row is 4 credits. Present only when the credits ledger decides access.

AccountSettings.description: Account defaults every key of this account resolves against. Set them with PATCH /v1/me/settings.

quality.description: Default transcript quality. Platform default: captions.

language.description: Default comma-separated caption language priority list, tried in order. Platform default: en.

timestamps.description: Default for the timestamps parameter. Platform default: true, which returns lines[].

TranscriptSettings.description: What a transcript request that names no parameter of its own receives.

url.description: The verify call, absolute: POST it with { email, code } once the code arrives.

next.description: The call that completes the signup.

expires_in.description: Seconds the code stays valid, from the moment it was sent.

key.description: The arc_sk_ account key. Shown once. Send it as Authorization: Bearer.

key_id.description: The key id. Appears on funnel events and in the dashboard; never a secret.

header.description: The pasteable request header line: Authorization: Bearer arc_sk_...

scopes.description: Always ["read"]. Create an Admin key in the dashboard for account write access.

tier.description: The plan the account is on: free for a new account, its plan when the address already had one.

rows_allotted.description: Plan credits a month, in rows (a row is 4 credits), on a paid plan. On the free plan, the account's allotment from before credits (1,000 for a new account). The free plan has 1,000 credits a month; read the balance from usage.credits on GET /v1/me.

next.description: A curl command for the first call: GET /v1/me with the key.

confidence.description: exact: one entity is named q (or the handle, id or alias), and no better-known person carries the name. single_fuzzy: the only entity returned, not an exact name. ambiguous: several exact matches, or an exact match next to a better-known person sharing the name (Jordan the brand vs Michael Jordan). fuzzy: only loose matches. none: no match.

label.description: One line to show the user: name, type, description, appearance count.

ask.description: Set when best and suggested are both null and several entities fit: show the options to the user, or check every option id against the data and answer per entity.

candidates.description: Entities considered: exact names first, then initials, whole-word, spelling and substring matches, each by appearance count.

note.description: One steering sentence for the agent reading this.

suggested.name: Sam Altman
suggested.description: CEO of OpenAI and former president of Y Combinator.
suggested.evidence: it has 4,399 appearances, 11x the next match (Sam Dunning, 397)

candidates.name: Sam
candidates.description: Common gender-neutral given name or nickname

example.note: No row is certain. suggested is Sam Altman (person) because it has 4,399 appearances, 11x the next match (Sam Dunning, 397). Use it and tell the user you assumed it.

id.description: Public entity id in the form "ent_{n}".

slug.description: URL slug. Null when the entity has never been slugged.

type.description: Entity type. Values: person (an individual), organization (a company or institution; legacy entities may read company or brand), product (a product or service), topic (a subject or theme), channel (a media source such as a YouTube channel), unknown (type was never classified).

appearance_count.description: Number of indexed appearances and mentions. Results are ordered by this, descending.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel id for channel entities. Null for every other type.

description.description: One catalog sentence that tells entities with the same name apart, for example "Common gender-neutral given name or nickname". Null when the catalog has none.

page.description: The entity's page on arcmira.com, absolute. Link the name to it when you write the entity into an answer. Null for a type the site has no page for.

match.description: How the entity's name relates to q: the whole name, a run of its words (Michael Jordan for Jordan), characters inside a word, the show's initials (My First Million for MFM), or a near spelling.

ResolveCandidate.description: The one entity q means. Set on exact and single_fuzzy only. Name it in the answer.

reason.description: Why this entity stands out: dominant (10x the appearances of the next match), only_word_match, context (the context parameter points at it), acronym, spelling.

evidence.description: The numbers or words behind the reason, to repeat to the user.

assumed.description: Always true: this is an assumption the answer must state.

ResolveSuggestion.description: Set when best is null but one entity stands out, with the reason and evidence. Use it and tell the user you assumed it.

id.description: Public entity id in the form "ent_{n}". Always the canonical entity id.

canonical_id.description: Public id of the canonical entity. Identical to id.

type.description: Entity type. Values: person (an individual), organization (a company or institution; legacy entities may read company or brand), product (a product or service), topic (a subject or theme), channel (a media source such as a YouTube channel), unknown (type was never classified).

platform.description: Source platform for channel entities, e.g. "youtube". Null unless the entity is platform-bound.

url.description: Canonical external URL for the entity. Null when none is known.

image_url.description: Entity image URL. Null until an image has been resolved.

image_checked_at.description: Timestamp of the last image resolution attempt. Null until the image pipeline has visited this entity.

appearance_count.description: Number of indexed appearances and mentions of this entity. 0 when never counted.

owner_entity_id.description: Public id ("ent_{n}") of the owning entity, e.g. the organization behind a product. Null unless an ownership link exists.

is_canonical.description: True when the id you supplied is the canonical entity. False when your id was merged into this canonical record.

merged_from_id.description: Public id you supplied when it differs from the canonical entity, i.e. your id was merged into this record. Null unless a merge redirect happened.

slug.description: URL slug, the site's canonical id for every type but channel. Null when never slugged.

route.description: Site-relative route of this entity's page on arcmira.com, e.g. "/org/ramp", "/person/jane-doe", "/yt/@TBPNLive". Null for a type the site has no page for.

page.description: The entity's page on arcmira.com, absolute. Link the name to it when you write the entity into an answer. Null for a type the site has no page for.

appearances_page.description: For a person, the list of their appearances on arcmira.com (their page opens on it). Null for every other type.

mentions_page.description: For a person, the list of mentions of them on arcmira.com, page/mentions. Null for every other type: their page is the mentions list already.

total_ad_reads.description: Total ad_read recommendations across all channels. 0 when none.

total_endorsements.description: Total endorsement recommendations across all channels. 0 when none.

unique_shows.description: Number of distinct shows/channels with commercial mentions of this entity.

first_seen_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest commercial mention. Null until the brand profile has been computed.

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent commercial mention. Null until the brand profile has been computed.

channels_as_sponsor.description: Number of channels where this entity appears in the curated known-advertisers dataset.

EntityDetailRecommendationsSummary.description: Commercial-intelligence rollup. Only present for organization and product entities when the caller has Recommendations API access (a Pro+ plan) and a brand profile exists.

has_more.description: True when more results exist past this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

allOf.description: The resolved entity the mentions belong to.

note.description: Present on a free preview page: where the list stops and the plan that lifts it. Say so rather than calling this every mention.

tier.description: The plan that lifts the preview.

url.description: Where to start that plan.

unlock.description: Present with note on a free preview page.

allOf.description: Present when your plan's freshness gate cut the window: where results on this plan stop. unlock names the plan that reads past it.

id.description: Public mention id in the form "men_{n}".

title.description: Video title. Null when the video was indexed without metadata.

url.description: Video URL. Null when unknown.

published_at.description: Video publish timestamp. Null when unknown.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id of the source channel. Null when unknown.

view_count.description: Video view count at index time. Null when never fetched.

id.description: Public entity id ("ent_{n}") of the source channel.

url.description: Source channel URL. Null when unknown.

source_channel.description: The channel entity that published the video. Null when the video has not been linked to a channel entity.

start_seconds.description: Start position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

end_seconds.description: End position in the video in integer seconds. 0 means "full episode / no specific moment". Null when the analyzer could not place it in time.

is_appearance.description: True when the person physically appears/speaks in the media (person entities only). Always false for organization, product, topic, and channel entities. Filtering with is_appearance=true on a non-person entity returns a 400 (appearances_person_only).

description.description: One sentence on why the entity comes up in this video, written to sit under the quoted line. Some mentions read in October 2026 hold the quoted transcript line instead. Null when not generated.

confidence.description: Analyzer confidence between 0 and 1. Null for legacy mentions analyzed before confidence scoring.

sentiment_score.description: Raw sentiment score between -1 and 1. Null when sentiment was not computed for this mention.

sentiment.description: Derived sentiment label from sentiment_score. Values: positive (score above 0.2), negative (score below -0.2), neutral (score between -0.2 and 0.2 inclusive, or no score computed).

referenced_url.description: URL referenced in the mention. Null unless one was extracted.

referenced_platform.description: Platform referenced in the mention, e.g. "twitter". Null unless one was extracted.

extracted_content.description: Verbatim content extracted for the mention. Null unless extraction ran.

items.description: Commercial mentions (sponsored and organic) for the same entity in the same video.

recommendations.description: Only present when the request used details=full (requires a Pro+ plan).

To correct a result, attach corrections to the exact query you ran: pass the feedback type, the query object you sent, and optional per-item corrections. Public submissions are recorded for human review (status "logged"); nothing is auto-applied. Read the review status back later via GET /v1/feedback/{feedback_id}. recommendations and channel_sponsors feedback types require a Pro+ plan; every other type needs read. monitor_alert feedback targets fired alerts: query carries monitor_id and/or tracker_id and/or alert_id, corrections target the alert id, and every referenced alert must belong to the caller (otherwise 404 alert_not_found). missed_alert corrections are expectations with nothing to target: omit the correction id and put { source_url, approximate_timestamp_seconds?, entity_id? } in suggested_change. delivery_issue corrections may carry { channel } in suggested_change. experience feedback says how a task went as a whole rather than correcting a result: it requires category and notes, refuses corrections (400 invalid_feedback_request), and needs no query. category and mcp_call_id, when sent, are recorded in the stored query.

get.description: Caption reads use 4 credits per started 15 minutes. quality=premium is one read. An owned transcript answers 200 ready at no charge. Otherwise this call starts a Premium transcript of the whole video, 300 credits per started 15 minutes, using credits from the account's plan first and then the account's on-demand budget up to its limit, and answers 202 pending with the job and Retry-After until the transcript is ready. Read again after Retry-After; repeated reads join the same job and never charge twice. When the last Premium transcript for the video failed, the read answers 200 state failed with the job and last_attempt and charges nothing; retry=true starts a new one. When the plan or the budget blocks, 403 paid_plan_required (with unlock) or 402 quota_exceeded or spend_limit_exceeded carries the price in quote and the limit it met in limit, and nothing is charged. A default-premium account with nothing owned reads captions with a note. On captions, start and end set the billed window: 4 credits per started 15 minutes of end minus start. On Premium they only trim the returned content, and the charge is the whole video. language selects caption tracks, timestamps=false returns paragraphs. Premium lines carry speaker and index, and the body carries speakers and revision. language picks the language: language= returns the base transcript (base_language), and a language the transcript is not in returns it translated, line for line with the same timestamps and speakers. Captions offer only the languages YouTube makes available for the video (translation_languages), billed as a caption read; any other language is Premium: an owned Premium transcript in another language costs the Premium rate once per account and language.

200.description: state ready: the transcript (video, quality, source, language, base_language, languages, translation_languages, lines or paragraphs, speakers and revision on Premium, rows_billed, as_of, note). state failed (Premium only): the last Premium transcript for this video failed; job and last_attempt say why, nothing was charged, and retry=true starts a new one.

202.description: state pending: the Premium transcript this read started or joined is in flight; job carries its status and poll interval. No transcript content yet.

402.description: quota_exceeded, spend_limit_exceeded, member_limit, on_demand_paused or fair_use_cap.
